title: AW27 Women's Trim Market Strategy
summary: In a low-growth year, put trim spend on tailoring and coats and keep ornament for hero evening pieces; avoid unverifiable eco claims.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fashion is expected to remain in low single-digit growth in 2027, with markdown risk from excess stock<sup>[1]</sup>
- EU Directive 2024/825 bans greenwashing and misleading environmental claims; Italy's transposing decree entered into force on 27 September 2026<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Build, test, sell through
sections.body:
| Action | Trims |
|---|---|
| Build | Horn and corozo buttons, piping |
| Test | Jewelled buckles, lace insets |
| Sell through | Heavy logo hardware |

commercial_implications: - Do not market "eco" trims without proof.
